newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 14.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 14.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 35 points to 7,922.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index ended last week at 1,017.61, down nearly 5.2 percent for the whole week.
* Ringgit dips sharply on Monday morning to 2.5385/15 to a dollar against 2.5042/52 at close of Kuala Lumpur on Friday.
* "As has happened in the region, stock prices should rise because of the sharp fall in ringgit," said a dealer with a bank-backed brokerage.
* Dealers said expect follow through buying to Friday's support from local institutions.
* Kuala Lumpur Industries Holdings KLIH.KL announces reverse takeover of Rahman Hydraulics. The two shares relist.
* Ekran, the builder of the controversial Bakun dam, announces plans to sell stake in Wembley
